title: Med spa results UGC ad
text: A UGC style med spa ad that moves from a worried selfie in the car to a confident result in the clinic
idea: Problem to result in one short story: a talking-to-camera opening, then the clinic setting and the visible change. The format matches how people share treatments on Instagram.
why: A relatable problem in the first second.
A clear move from before to after.
Phone-style framing that fits Reels and TikTok.
